_comment_header: Compile-time-embedded baseline tier configuration for the OSS
ProximaDB image. Loaded via include_str! into the binary so the
engine is self-contained for offline / air-gapped deployments.
This file is intentionally domain-neutral. It carries operational
concerns only — tier ids, prometheus labels, soft caps. Commercial
concerns (currency, prices, billing primitives, marketing copy)
belong in operator-side overlay artifacts. See config/TIER_CONFIG.md
for the schema contract and config/tier-config.example.json for a
richer 3-tier example layout operators can copy.
Operators (including AnvaiOps) overlay this file at Docker build
Overlay JSON may use any tier ids that map to a Tier variant via
the serde aliases declared in src/catalog/tenant_tier.rs.
File still named pricing.json (not tier-config.json) during the
Phase B-4 migration window — Phase B-5 will rename + update the
include_str! path + the anvaiops commercial-image COPY destination
